rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person who is unmarried or has no romantic partner.

example.english: I’m a single person and am not planning to date for now.
example.traditional: 我係單身人士，暫時唔諗住拍拖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 daan1 san1 jan4 si6 zaam6 si4 m4 nam2 zyu6 paak3 to1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “single” means one only rather than unmarried or designed for one person.

example.english: Please give me a single one-way ticket.
example.traditional: 請畀我一張單程飛，唔該。
example.jyutping: cing2 bei2 ngo5 jat1 zoeng1 daan1 cing4 fei1 m4 goi1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on being alone or not accompanied by anything else, rather than merely being one in number.

example.english: I want to take a single-person trip this time.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 soeng2 daan1 duk6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this when someone is unmarried and without a romantic partner.

example.english: I’m still single and not dating anyone.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 daan1 san1 mou5 paak3 to1

rows.note: Use this for a music release sold or promoted separately from an album.

example.english: This single became a hit as soon as it came out.
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 daan1 kuk1 jat1 ceot1 zau6 hung4 zo2

rows.note: Use this before a noun such as 房 or 床 when something is designed for one person.

example.english: This is a single room, perfect for you.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 hai6 daan1 jan4 fong2 ngaam1 saai3 nei5
